definition: to pause because you are unsure
description: A young woman in a lilac puffer jacket and a red harness stands at the edge of a metal platform on a snowy stone bridge high above a rocky gorge, a bungee rope hanging below her. She leans forward with her arms stretched out as if to jump, then pulls back, straightens up and stops. A man in an orange jacket and a black beanie stands right next to her. She stares down into the deep drop and does not move, while behind the railing one friend cheers with raised fists and another holds her hands over her mouth.

taps.phrase: to stare down into the gorge
to steady her with his hand
